# Load phyloseq object

```{r load-ps}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("/Users/joanakrause/Documents/feina/Projects/coral_meta/data/ps_final.rds")
```

# ALL SAMPLES

## Alpha diversity — general steps

```{r alpha-prep}
# Remove taxa with zero counts
ps_nonzero <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_plas_V3_V4) > 0, ps_plas_V3_V4)

# Calculate Shannon diversity
df_shannon <- microbiome::alpha(ps_nonzero, index = "shannon")
kable(head(df_shannon))

# Add Shannon values to sample metadata
df_metadata         <- meta(ps_nonzero)
df_metadata$Shannon <- as.numeric(df_shannon$diversity_shannon)
kable(head(df_metadata))
```

## Coral health

### Normality diagnostics

```{r normality-coral-health}
# Shapiro-Wilk test per group — tryCatch skips groups with n < 3 or n > 5000
# Only "healthy" deviates from normality, but the overall assumption is violated
# if any group fails — use non-parametric tests throughout
shapiro_health <- lapply(
  split(df_metadata$Shannon, df_metadata$coral_health),
  function(x) tryCatch(shapiro.test(x), error = function(e) e)
)
shapiro_health
```

```{r normality-plots-coral-health}
p_hist <- ggplot(df_metadata, aes(x = Shannon, fill = coral_health)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "black", bins = 20, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ coral_health, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Shannon diversity", x = "Shannon Index", y = "Frequency")

p_qq <- ggplot(df_metadata, aes(sample = Shannon, color = coral_health)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ coral_health, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Q-Q Plots for Shannon values",
       x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles")

p_normality <- p_hist / p_qq
ggsave(
  "/Users/joanakrause/Documents/feina/Projects/coral_meta/analysis/alpha_div/Shannon_Normality_Diagnostics_coralhealth.pdf",
  p_normality, width = 8, height = 10
)
```

### Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)

```{r pval-coral-health}
# Factor levels define group order and are used for both the p-value table and plot
df_metadata$coral_health <- factor(df_metadata$coral_health,
                                   levels = c("disease", "healthy", "bleached"))

pairs_coral_health <- combn(levels(df_metadata$coral_health), 2, simplify = FALSE)

pval_table <- lapply(pairs_coral_health, function(pair) {
  sub <- df_metadata %>%
    filter(coral_health %in% pair) %>%
    mutate(coral_health = droplevels(coral_health))
  counts <- table(sub$coral_health)
  if (any(counts < 2)) {
    return(data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = NA_real_))
  }
  res <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(Shannon ~ coral_health, data = sub),
    error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_)
  )
  data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = res$p.value)
}) %>% bind_rows()

pval_table$P_adjusted <- p.adjust(pval_table$P_value, method = "BH")
pval_table$Significance <- cut(
  pval_table$P_adjusted,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
  labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns"),
  right  = FALSE
)

# Data frame of BH-significant pairs for stat_pvalue_manual
# (uses the pre-computed BH-adjusted stars directly, not ggpubr's internal test)
signif_df_ch <- pval_table %>%
  filter(P_adjusted < 0.05) %>%
  transmute(
    group1   = as.character(Group1),
    group2   = as.character(Group2),
    p.signif = as.character(Significance)
  )

# Format for display / export
pval_out            <- pval_table
pval_out$P_value    <- format(pval_table$P_value,    scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
pval_out$P_adjusted <- format(pval_table$P_adjusted, scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
print(pval_out)

write.csv(
  pval_out,
  "/Users/joanakrause/Documents/feina/Projects/coral_meta/analysis/alpha_div/pval_table_coral_health.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Boxplot

```{r plot-coral-health}
custom_colors <- c(
  "disease"  = "#ad6a6cff",
  "healthy"  = "#6c9a8bff",
  "bleached" = "#eed2ccff"
)

coralhealth_counts <- table(df_metadata$coral_health)
coralhealth_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(names(coralhealth_counts), "\n(n=", coralhealth_counts, ")"),
  names(coralhealth_counts)
)

plot_coral_health <- ggboxplot(
  df_metadata,
  x    = "coral_health",
  y    = "Shannon",
  fill = "coral_health"
) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = coralhealth_labels) +
  labs(x = "Coral health", y = "Shannon diversity index") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    plot.margin     = margin(t = 2, r = 5, b = 10, l = 15, unit = "mm"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

if (nrow(signif_df_ch) > 0) {
  max_y <- max(df_metadata$Shannon, na.rm = TRUE)
  signif_df_ch$y.position <- max_y * 1.05 +
    (seq_len(nrow(signif_df_ch)) - 1) * max_y * 0.08
  plot_coral_health <- plot_coral_health +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      signif_df_ch,
      label = "p.signif"   # BH-adjusted stars from pval_table$Significance
    )
}

print(plot_coral_health)

pdf(
  "/Users/joanakrause/Documents/feina/Projects/coral_meta/analysis/alpha_div/alpha_coralhealth.pdf",
  width = 5, height = 5
)
print(plot_coral_health)
dev.off()

# Summary table
shannon_summary_health <- df_metadata %>%
  group_by(coral_health) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n            = sum(!is.na(Shannon)),
    mean_Shannon = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_Shannon   = sd(Shannon,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shannon_summary_health %>%
  mutate(mean_sd = sprintf("%.3f +/- %.3f", mean_Shannon, sd_Shannon)) %>%
  select(coral_health, n, mean_sd)

write.csv(
  shannon_summary_health,
  "/Users/joanakrause/Documents/feina/Projects/coral_meta/analysis/alpha_div/shannon_summary_allsamples_coralhealth.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
